headword: {昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}
reading: こんちゅうさいしゅう

definitions.explanation: The activity of catching and preserving insects, traditionally a popular summer hobby for Japanese children, often as a school break project.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みに{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}をした。
examples.english: I went bug collecting over summer vacation.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}は{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}が{趣味|しゅみ}だ。
examples.english: My older brother's hobby is insect collecting.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}を{自由|じゆう}{研究|けんきゅう}のテーマにすることにした。
examples.english: My son decided to make insect collecting the theme of his summer research project.

notes:
Compound of {昆虫|こんちゅう} (insect) + {採集|さいしゅう} (gathering, collecting). A classic summer-vacation activity in Japan, often combined with a {自由|じゆう}{研究|けんきゅう} (independent research) school assignment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}に{行|い}く: to go bug collecting
- {昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}セット: insect-collecting kit (net, case, etc.)
- {夏休|なつやす}みの{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}: summer-vacation insect collecting

CULTURAL NOTE:
The stereotypical kit includes a {虫取|むしと}り{網|あみ} (insect net) and a {虫|むし}かご (insect cage). Popular target insects include {蝉|せみ} (cicadas), {蝶|ちょう} (butterflies), and カブトムシ (rhinoceros beetles).
